name: ml-computer-vision
description: Use when the user asks about image classification, object detection, segmentation, Ultralytics YOLO, torchvision models, augmentation, mAP/IoU or CV model export (ONNX, TensorRT). Produces task and model choice, preprocessing and augmentation pipeline and training/eval config. Not for VLM image understanding (use multimodal-pipelines) or image generation (use genai-vision).
